$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for IDE support

target.description: Deploy target runtime. Defaults to "cloudflare". Non-CF targets disable bindings (D1, KV, R2, AI) and produce a plain Hono app.

output.description: Output mode. "server" (default) serves all pages dynamically. "static" prerenders all pages at build time, writing HTML files to dist/client/.

auth.description: High-level Better Auth configuration. Use this to select built-in auth providers; use auth.ts for advanced Better Auth options.

providers.description: Auth providers to enable. Include "email" for email/password auth. Social providers use standardized env vars like AUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and AUTH_GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.

head.description: Default <head> tags for all pages. Page-level head() exports override these defaults.

titleTemplate.description: Title template — %s is replaced with the page title. Example: "%s | My Site"

htmlAttrs.description: Attributes to add to the <html> element. Example: { "lang": "en" }

bodyAttrs.description: Attributes to add to the <body> element

routing.description: Routing configuration — headers, redirects, rewrites, fallbacks, revalidation, prerendering.

revalidate.description: Edge caching TTL in seconds. A number sets a global TTL for all SSR pages. An object maps URL patterns to TTLs (first match wins). Set to 0 to disable caching for a path.

prerender.description: Explicit paths to prerender at deploy time. Each path must start with "/".

headers.description: Custom response headers for static assets. Keys are URL patterns (e.g. "/assets/*"), values are arrays of "Name: value" strings.

redirects.description: URL redirects. Keys are source URL patterns; values are destination strings (302) or objects with "to" and optional "status".

rewrites.description: URL rewrites. Keys are source URL patterns; values are destination paths. Serves content from the destination without changing the browser URL.

fallbacks.description: Fallback rewrites. Same shape as `rewrites`, but only fire when no static asset matched the request. Useful for SPA shells or default-locale catch-alls without pre-empting real routes.

inference.description: Inference configuration — bindings, scanDirs, build, outputDir, appType.

bindings.description: Explicitly control inferred Cloudflare bindings. If omitted, bindings are inferred by scanning source files.

db.description: Enable D1 database binding. `true` uses default name "DB", a string sets a custom binding name.

kv.description: Enable KV namespace binding. `true` uses default name "KV", a string sets a custom binding name.

storage.description: Enable R2 bucket binding. `true` uses default name "STORAGE", a string sets a custom binding name.

scanDirs.description: Directories to scan for binding inference, relative to the project root. Overrides the default scan directories.

build.description: Custom build command. Overrides the framework preset's default build command.

outputDir.description: Output directory for static deploys. Relative to project root.

appType.description: App type. If omitted, auto-detected on first deploy.

remote.description: Connect to remote D1/KV/R2 bindings during local development. Can also be set via VOID_REMOTE=1 environment variable.

worker.description: Curated wrangler config passthrough. Cloudflare-targeted apps require compatibility_date here unless provided by wrangler.jsonc/wrangler.json; Void pins the latest known-good date here if none is configured. Binding arrays (d1_databases, kv_namespaces, r2_buckets) are not allowed here — bindings are fully managed by void.

database.description: Database backend. Omit for D1 (SQLite, default). Set to "pg" for PostgreSQL via Hyperdrive.
